name: Board Member Statement of Financial Interests
description: Statement of financial interests filed before taking office, annually while serving, and the year after leaving the Board.
deadline: Before taking the oath of office; annually by May 1 while serving; by May 1 of the year after leaving the Board
quote: Shall file a statement of financial interests with the Board Secretary or designee at the following times: Before taking the oath of office or entering upon their duties. Annually by May 1 while serving on the Board. By May 1 of the year after leaving the Board.
